title: NCT 127 Reveal Release Date For Seventh Full-Length Album, ‘BLINGY’
summary: The nine-track LP due out on Aug. 24 will coincide with the K-pop group's 10th anniversary.
contentText:
K-pop supergroup NCT 127 announced the release date for their upcoming seventh full-length album on Monday (July 27). The nine-track BLINGY will be released on all major streaming platforms and in physical editions on Aug. 24 through SM Entertainment/Virgin Music Group.

The LP will be part of the seven-man group’s celebration of their 10th anniversary, with a release promising that BLINGY “looks back on the group’s journey while opening a new chapter … [reflecting] the pride, confidence and strong bond that continue to define the group.”

Since debuting in 2016, the group featuring members JOHNNY, TAEYONG, YUTA, DOYOUNG, JAEHYUN, JUNGWOO and HAECHAN has scored a series of chart hits, with song such as “Fire Truck,” “Cherry Bomb,” “Kick It,” “Sticker” and “Fact Check,” as well as a series of top 10 albums on the Billboard 200, including Sticker: The 3rd Album (No. 3, 2021), 2 Baddies (No. 3, 2022) and NCT #127: Neo Zone, the 2nd Album (No. 5, 2020).

NCT 127’s fifth tour, Neo City — The Redline, will kick off at Seoul’s KSPO Dome on Sept. 18 and feature stops in Jakarta, Hong Kong, Singapore, Bangkok and Taipei, all without member Mark, who departed the group in April , as well as DOYOUNG AND JUNGWOO, who are on hiatus due to mandatory South Korean military service.

Before launching the tour, NCT 127 will headline KCON LA on Aug. 14, where they will perform alongside TOMORROW X TOGETHER, P1Harmony, KickFlip, SANTOS BRAVOS, TREASURE, &TEAM, ZEROBASEONE, ILLIT, ALLDAY PROJECT, ALPHA DRIVE ONE and more at the three-day event at Crypto.com Arena and the Los Angeles Convention Center.
